text:
Priya: Sandpiper-6B (int8) onboarding intake — quick sync. Goal: get a hosted canary + dedicated canary this week. Need smoke plan, perf targets, fallback mapping, and eval pass/fail criteria. tagging owners: @Rafael (perf), @Maya (quality/evals), @Jason (infra).

Rafael: Taking perf. First q: what quantization path are we testing? static int8 (GPTQ) + layernorm fallback? or dynamic int8? also: target P95 for 256-token chat?

Priya: We'll start with GPTQ-style static int8 (existing convert script) and a fallback path to fp16 for failing layers. Target P95 <= 200ms on A100-40GB baseline for 256 tokens; P95 <= 350ms on the lowest-tier dedicated instance (for cost accounting). If numbers look off, fall back to mixed-int8 (some layers fp16).

Maya: I'll own eval deck. Plan to run: 1) regen-suite (1000 prompts), 2) redwood-eval-safety (toxicity + hallucination), 3) domain-lm-check for our top-5 customers. Pass criteria proposal: quality delta <= 1.5% relative to fp16 baseline on regen-suite (exact metric: mean ROUGE-L) and safety failure rate < 0.5%. If we see regressions > threshold we gate.

Jason: Infra asks: HF repo link, conversion script, target container tag, and a sample inference command. Also requesting 2x dedicated GPUs for canary (48h reservation) and a canary traffic split config (5% -> 20% -> 50%).

Priya: HF link: https://huggingface.co/redwood/sandpiper-6b (private). Conversion: tools/convert_gptq.sh + quant recipes under eng-ml/quant-recipes/sandpiper_v1.yaml. Container tag: redwood/sandpiper:int8-v1. Sample command below.

Priya: ```bash
curl -sS -X POST https://api.redwood.com/v1/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"sandpiper-6b-int8-v1","input":"Tell me a short story about a lighthouse","max_tokens":256,"stream":false}'
```

Maya: QA checklist (short):
- [ ] Run regen-suite vs fp16 baseline (n=1000)
- [ ] Run safety + robustness tests (adversarial prompts)
- [ ] Run perf-quality tradeoff sweep (top-k, temp, cache warmup)
- [ ] Human spot-check 50 samples across 5 domains
If any of the above fail thresholds, do not promote to >=20% traffic.

Rafael: Perf checklist:
- [ ] Cold-start latency (1st token) and warm P95 for 256/1024 contexts
- [ ] Throughput @ batch sizes 1,4,8 and respective token/s numbers
- [ ] KV cache memory profile and host GPU memory pressure (watch for OOM at 1024)
- [ ] Cost-per-100k-tokens estimate compared to fp16 and previous 6B variant
I'll post numbers by EOD.

Jason: Canary rollout plan (infra):
1) Provision 2x A100-40GB dedicated nodes (canary pool). deploy-bot will reserve for 72h.
2) Smoke tests (health, perf, basic quality) on pool 
3) Start hosted traffic: 5% -> monitor 1h -> 20% -> monitor 3h -> 50% -> monitor 6h -> full.
4) Auto-fallback policy: on latency SLO breach (P95 > 250ms for >5m) or quality regression alarm from evals, route affected requests to sandpiper-fp16-v1 or previous stable.

deploy-bot: Reserved canary pool: 2 x A100-40GB for team-eng-ml, expires in 72h. Reservation ID: rsv_199832.

Priya: Rollout gating signals (automated + manual):
- Automated: perf monitors (latency/cost), QA regression alerts (Maya's tests), error-rate >0.5% spikes.
- Manual: product signoff for customer-facing changes, security review complete.

Maya: I'll wire up dashboards: regen delta, safety failure rate, human-sample flags. Also will push an initial eval run now and attach CSV.

Rafael: Quick note — warmup scripts should pre-fill KV cache for common prefixes. I'll share a warmup snippet.

Rafael: ```python
# warmup example
for p in common_prompts:
    client.generate(model="sandpiper-6b-int8-v1", input=p, max_tokens=64)
```

Jason: Also adding a traffic-split snippet for canary: `{ "canary": 0.05, "stage": 0.2, "stable": 0.75 }` — we can tweak.

Priya: Outstanding items before canary go:
- [ ] Infra: confirm reservation + container image available
- [ ] ML: conversion artifacts + perf numbers
- [ ] QA: evals + human spot-check OK
- [ ] Security: short risk review (cache side channels check)
Let's aim to start the 5% hosted route tomorrow morning PST. :thumbsup:

Jason: acknowledged. reserving infra + will push image to staging by 09:00 PST.

Maya: kicking off evals now. will update with CSV link.

Rafael: running perf suite; will post graphs here in ~2h.

Priya: Great — thanks team. We'll reconvene in #eng-ml sync if any blockers.
